content.title: ‘Foul Play with Anthony Davis’ premieres tonight - How to watch for free
content.text: "Foul Play with Anthony Davis" premieres on Monday, April 6 on TBS (photo courtesy of TBS).TBSIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Ariana Tourangeau | atourangeau@masslive.comAthletes from all sports pull pranks on their oblivious teammates and sports-world friends in the new series “Foul Play with Anthony Davis,” premiering on Monday, April 6. The series premieres at 11:30 p.m. ET on TBS following the NCAA Men’s Basketball Championship. Those without cable can watch the show for free through DIRECTV, which offers a free trial to new users. Sling and HBO Max are other options for streaming the show and promotional offers are available.In “Foul Play With Anthony Davis,” athletes pull pranks on their teammates and friends with an assist from the creative team behind “Impractical Jokers” and an ensemble cast of writers/performers who help them see the prank through from the opening tip-off to the final buzzer.In the series premiere, “LeBron James and super agent Rich Paul team up with Anthony Davis to prank NBA star Draymond Green with an ultra-exclusive investment opportunity, while Olympic gymnast Jordan Chiles traps WNBA star Rickea Jackson in a parking-lot nightmare.”Below is a look at the series from Entertainment Tonight’s YouTube Channel:Watch TBS’s “Foul Play with Anthony Davis” on DirecTV with a 5-day free trialStreaming ServiceStarting Monthly PriceFree TrialFree Trial LengthMax DiscountDIRECTV$89.99Yes5 days$40 off first monthHBO Max$10.99NoN/AN/ASling TV$45.99NoN/A$30 off first monthHow can I watch “Foul Play with Anthony Davis” without cable?Those without cable can watch the show for free through DIRECTV, which offers a free trial to new users.
